While shepherds watched their fields that day.
The angels filled the sky with song —
Heavenly Father’s promise, waited long.

And knelt beside the place He lay.
When you feel small or far from home,
Heavenly Father sees; you’re not alone.

But Jesus lay in peaceful sleep.

And sea and sky obeyed His will.
A boy brought loaves and fishes small,
Not nearly near enough for all.
But Jesus blessed the gift he gave,
And thousands ate beside the wave.

Then Jesus wept beside her too —
He knows your tears; He cries with you.
